product_family: WriterZen is an SEO content workflow platform (Topic Discovery, Keyword Explorer, Keyword Planner, GPT-powered Content Creator/A.I. Assistant, Plagiarism Checker) with a Team Function/Enterprise tier for agencies; single consumer/team product line, no separate self-hosted or API-only SKU observed.

certifications.name: SOC 2 (Type 1/2)
certifications.proof_quote: no public evidence, no trust center, security page, or SOC 2 mention found on writerzen.net home page, privacy policy, terms of service, or cookie policy; /security returns HTTP 404

certifications.name: ISO 27001
certifications.proof_quote: no public evidence on writerzen.net. Note: search results returned ISO 27001/27701/42001 certifications for 'WRITER' (writer.com), a different company; this does NOT apply to WriterZen (writerzen.net, operated by Resonance Technology Pte. Ltd., Singapore) and must not be conflated

certifications.name: GDPR
certifications.proof_quote: Privacy Policy and Cookie Policy contain no reference to GDPR, EU data subject rights, or a lawful-basis framework. Terms of Service instead commit to Singapore's Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA): 'Client Personal Data transferred outside Singapore will be protected at a standard that is comparable to that under the PDPA.' No explicit GDPR posture is stated.

certifications.name: HIPAA
certifications.proof_quote: no public evidence; HIPAA is not mentioned anywhere on writerzen.net; product is a general SEO/content tool, not marketed for healthcare use

certifications.name: PCI DSS
certifications.proof_quote: no public evidence on writerzen.net; payment processing details (likely via a third-party processor) are not documented on the vendor's own pages

certifications.name: ISO/IEC 42001 (AI governance)
certifications.proof_quote: no public evidence; no AI-governance certification claims found on writerzen.net despite the product's GPT-powered AI Assistant feature

privacy.ai_training_note: Neither the Privacy Policy nor the Terms of Service mentions whether user content or prompts submitted to the GPT-powered Content Creator / A.I. Assistant is used to train WriterZen's or any third-party AI model, and there is no stated opt-out. Terms of Service state 'WriterZen shall not access the Client's Data except to respond to service or technical problems, or at the Client's request,' and 'The Client shall retain all right, title and interest in and to all of their data,' but this does not address model-training use. Given the product wraps GPT (OpenAI) for content generation, prompt handling is likely governed by the underlying API provider's terms, which are not disclosed on writerzen.net. Treat AI-training posture as unconfirmed.
privacy.data_region: Singapore (company operating offices); Terms of Service reference Singapore's Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA) as the governing standard for data transferred outside Singapore

security.name: General security commitment
security.value: Privacy Policy: 'While We strive to use commercially acceptable means to protect Your Personal Data, We cannot guarantee its absolute security.' Terms of Service: WriterZen commits to 'reasonable security arrangements' including 'physical, administrative, procedural and information & communications technology measures' to prevent unauthorized access.

security.name: Data deletion
security.value: Terms of Service: upon request WriterZen will 'return to the Client, all Client Personal Data' or 'delete all Client Personal Data' with written confirmation.

security.name: Third-party auth
security.value: Privacy Policy notes collection of data via Google, Facebook, and Twitter when users authenticate through these services (OAuth-style sign-in), no further detail on token handling.

products.name: WriterZen (core plans: Basic, Professional, etc.)

compare.pricing_model: Subscription SaaS with a 15-day free trial (no credit card required); Enterprise/Team tier for agencies
compare.data_residency: Singapore (vendor operating offices); no dedicated EU/US data residency options documented
